description:
Find all genes in a specific Reactome pathway.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table target_pathways — one record = one Reactome pathway annotation of one gene.
Key: id, pathways[].pathwayId, pathways[].topLevelTerm.
Arguments: pathway_id accepts reactome pathway (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: ranked by id asc (verified by the harness); one row = one item (one Reactome pathway annotation of one gene); `_vbt.total` counts items; `_vbt.grains.membership` counts memberships; `_vbt.grains.gene` counts genes; `_vbt.grains.pathway` counts pathways.
topLevelTerm keeps one value of reactome_pathway; records under several are missed.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Lowest-level Reactome annotations, not propagated to every ancestor; a gene missing from a pathway is unannotated there.

pathway_id.description: Accepts reactome_pathway; resolved to one reactome_pathway (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
